digest.component_or_area: LLM runner telemetry and job instrumentation
propositions: Weekly LLM jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval) make billable API calls but produce no retrievable token usage record; per-call usage is captured in PydanticAIRunner.run but lost at job exit because eval path drops _usage and external pytest surfaces nothing.

A process-level usage sink must be added at the shared _usage seam in runner.py to record input/output/cache tokens and request count as JSONL when env var REBAR_USAGE_LOG is set, covering both weekly jobs without per-test plumbing.

Both weekly job workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to a temp file path, call a CLI summarize command to append Markdown totals and per-op breakdown to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload the raw JSONL artifact.

New module src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py must expose record(usage, *, op) function that appends one JSON line per call when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is set (no-op when unset) and summarize(path) function that reads JSONL and returns Markdown summary or 'No LLM calls recorded.' for empty/missing files.
